title: Somewhere and the last time he came on my bottom when was it the night Boylan gave my hand a great squeeze going along by the Tolka in my hand there steals another I just pressed the back of his like that with my thumb to squeeze back
html_source:
Molly confirms Leopold’s unusual sexual actions. The reader had a hint that Leopold masturbated on Sandymount Strand looking up Gerty mcDowell’s dress and now she confirms it for us – he’s a bit weird in the bedroom department.Molly also smacks us in the face with her candid sexuality. Nora Barnacle, Joyce’s wife was similar, famously/infamously grabbing Joyce’s down below on their first date !

Joyce also makes it clear that Molly is not a mythically faithful Penelope, Boylan grabbed her hand by the Tolka, in other words, Molly is a real woman (Norris, M Virgin and Veteran Readings of Ulysses).

In Chapter 8, Bloom recalls that on the last full moon (two weeks ago Sunday), he and Boylan walked down by the Tolka River with Molly between them. Molly and Boylan were humming a song to each other and touching.
